title: Hackathon
summary: A hackathon project that predicts Ames, Iowa house sale prices from 79 features using PySpark and Spark MLlib, containerized with Docker; SDV's GaussianCopula synthesizer (via sdv.tabular) is run in generate_sdv.py to augment the small 1460-row training set with synthetic data, and sdv.evaluation.evaluate is called to assess the synthetic data quality.
evidence: generate_sdv.py:2-3 'from sdv.tabular import GaussianCopula' and 'from sdv.evaluation import evaluate' called to generate and evaluate synthetic training data
